aiConsent.title: Before you use AI features
aiConsent.intro: Coach and Deep Analysis send some of your information to outside AI providers to generate a reply or a report.
aiConsent.dataShared: What's shared: your first name, savings goals and progress, monthly income, and the messages or requests you send.
aiConsent.providers: Who receives it: Coach messages are processed by OpenAI. Deep Analysis reports are processed by OpenAI and Anthropic.
aiConsent.retention: We don't control how long these providers keep request logs after generating a reply.
